    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg=i[0][0]
    Ci=comps_of(i,bg); Co=comps_of(o,bg)
    tpls=[(c,p) for c,p in Ci if len(p)>1]
    results=[]
    for c,p in Co:
        if len(p)<=1 or (c,p) in tpls: continue
        ys=[y for y,_ in p]; xs=[x for _,x in p]
        tl=(min(ys),min(xs))
        srel=frozenset((y-tl[0],x-tl[1]) for y,x in p)
        tplrels=[norm(b) for a,b in tpls]
        matches=[a for a,s2 in zip([a for a,_ in tpls],tplrels) if s2==srel]
        results.append((c,tl,len(p),matches))
    return bg,results,sorted([(c,list(p)[0]) for c,p in Ci if len(p)==1])
for n in range(1,6):
    bg,res,mks=analyze(n)
    print('demo',n,'bg',bg)
    for r in res: print('   ',r)
    print('   marks',mks)

def stamps_and_markers(n):
    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg=i[0][0]
    Ci=comps_of(i,bg); Co=comps_of(o,bg)
    tpls=[(c,p) for c,p in Ci if len(p)>1]
    mk=[(i[list(p)[0][0]][list(p)[0][1]],list(p)[0]) for c,p in Ci if len(p)==1]
    out=[]
    for c,p in Co:
        tl=(min(y for y,_ in p),min(x for _,x in p))
        k=frozenset((y-tl[0],x-tl[1]) for y,x in p)
        if len(p)<=1: continue
        # is it in input?
        inp_in=any(frozenset(q)==k for cc,q in Ci if cc==c and len(q)>1)
        if inp_in: continue
        hits=[]
        for mc,pos in mk:
            if (pos[0]-tl[0],pos[1]-tl[1]) in k: hits.append(mc)
        out.append((c,tl,hits,k,tls:=None))
    return tpls,mk,out
for n in [1,3,4,5]:
    tpls,mk,outs=stamps_and_markers(n)
    print('=== demo',n,'bg',i:=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'][0][0])
    for tpl in tpls:
        print('  template',tpl[0],'TL',min(y for y,_ in tpl[1]),min(x for _,x in tpl[1]))
    for c,tl,hits,k,_ in outs:
        print('  stamp c=',c,'TL=',tl,'on-markers',hits)

import json
def f(g,prefer=None):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg}
    used=set(); comps=[]
    for p in sorted(S):
        if p in used: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q); comp.append(q)
            i,j=q
            for a in(-1,0,1):
                for b in(-1,0,1):
                    r=(i+a,j+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        comps.append(comp)
    templates=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]
    singles=[p for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    res=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    info={}
    for t in templates:
        cnt=Counter(g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in t)
        maj=max(cnt.values()); mkv=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v<maj]
        main=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==maj][0]
        emb=[p for p in t if g[p[0]][p[1]] in mkv][0]
        offs=[(p[0]-emb[0],p[1]-emb[1]) for p in t if p!=emb]
        info[t]=(offs,main,mkv)
    # decide per single: which template? prefer=None -> direct color match
    stamps=[]
    for s in singles:
        c=g[s[0]][s[1]]
        cand=[t for t,(offs,main,mk) in info.items() if c in mk]
        assert len(cand)==1, (s,c,cand)
        offs,main,_=info[cand[0]]
        stamps.append((s,offs,main))
    # determine orientation per marker: choose orientation minimizing writes on non-bg
    for s,offs,color in stamps:
        best=None
        for o in (offs,[(dr,-dc) for dr,dc in offs]):
            nw=sum(1 for dr,dc in o if 0<=s[0]+dr<H and 0<=s[1]+dc<W and g[s[0]+dr][s[1]+dc]==bg)
            if best is None or nw>best[0]: best=(nw,o)
        o=best[1]
        for dr,dc in o:
            i,j=s[0]+dr,s[1]+dc
            if 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]==bg: res[i][j]=color
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'], f(G[k+' input'],None)==G[k+' output'] if False else '')

def comps_of(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg};used=set();out=[]
    for p in sorted(S):

        st=[p];comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q);comp.append(q)
            i,j=q
            for a in(-1,0,1):

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps_of(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg};used=set();out=[]
    for p in sorted(S):
        if p in used: continue
        st=[p];comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q);comp.append(q)
            i,j=q
            for a in(-1,0,1):
                for b in(-1,0,1):
                    r=(i+a,j+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        out.append(comp)
    return out
def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=comps_of(g,bg)
    templ=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    sgcolors={g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in singles}
    res=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    for t in templ:
        cnt=Counter(g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in t)
        maj=max(cnt.values()); mains=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==maj][0]
        others=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v<maj]
        if len(others)!=1: continue
        ec=others[0]
        if ec not in {g[s[0]][s[1]] for s in singles}: continue
        e=[p for p in t if g[p[0]][p[1]]==ec][0]
        offs=[(p[0]-e[0],p[1]-e[1]) for p in t if p!=e]
        for s in singles:
            if g[s[0]][s[1]]!=ec: continue
            best=None
            for o in (offs,[(dr,-dc) for dr,dc in offs]):
                n=sum(1 for dr,dc in o if 0<=s[0]+dr<H and 0<=s[1]+dc<W and g[s[0]+dr][s[1]+dc]==bg)
                if best is None or n>best[0]: best=(n,o)
            for dr,dc in best[1]:
                i,j=s[0]+dr,s[1]+dc
                if 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]==bg: res[i][j]=mains
    return res
ok=True

            for a in(-1,0,1):
                for b in(-1,0,1):
                    r=(i+a,j+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        out.append(comp)
    return out

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=comps_of(g,bg)
    templ=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    sgcolors={g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in singles}
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for t in templ:
        cnt=Counter(g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in t)
        maj=max(cnt.values()); mains=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==maj][0]
        others=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v<maj]
        if len(others)!=1: continue
        ec=others[0]
        if ec not in sgcolors: continue
        e=[p for p in t if g[p[0]][p[1]]==ec][0]
        offs=[(p[0]-e[0],p[1]-e[1]) for p in t if p!=e]
        mir=[(dr,-dc) for dr,dc in offs]
        for s in singles:
            if g[s[0]][s[1]]!=ec: continue
            best=None
            for o in (offs,mir):
                n=sum(1 for dr,dc in o if 0<=s[0]+dr<H and 0<=s[1]+dc<W)
                blocked=sum(1 for dr,dc in o if 0<=s[0]+dr<H and 0<=s[1]+dc<W and g[s[0]+dr][s[1]+dc]!=bg)
                score=(n-blocked,-blocked*2)
                if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,o)
            for dr,dc in best[1]:
                i,j=s[0]+dr,s[1]+dc

def solve_full(di,order='bigfirst'):
    H=len(di);W=len(di[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in di for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ccs=cc(di,bg)
    tmpl=[c for c in ccs if len(c)>1]
    marks=[(c[0],di[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]) for c in ccs if len(c)==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in di]
    tpls=sorted(tmpl,key=len,reverse=True) if order=='bigfirst' else sorted(tmpl,key=len)
    for tp in tpls:
        cnt=Counter(di[p[0]][p[1]] for p in tp)
        mc=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1][0]
        e=[p for p in tp if di[p[0]][p[1]]==mc][0]
        for pos,col in marks:
            if col!=mc: continue
            for (i,j) in tp:
                ni,nj=i-e[0]+pos[0],j-e[1]+pos[1]
                if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W:
                    out[ni][nj]=di[i][j]
    return out
for order in ['bigfirst','smallfirst']:
    res=[]
    for k in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
        ok=solve_full(G[k+' input'],order)==G[k+' output']
        res.append((k,ok))

from collections import Counter
def cc(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg}; out=[];used=set()
    for p in sorted(S):
        if p in used: continue
        st=[p];cp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q);cp.append(q)
            for a in(-1,0,1):
                for b in(-1,0,1):
                    r=(q[0]+a,q[1]+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        out.append(cp)
    return out
# Rule: for each multi-cell template, paint identity stamps whose minority-color cell coincides with a single-cell marker of that color.
def solve(di):
    H=len(di);W=len(di[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in di for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ccs=cc(di,bg)
    singles=[next(iter(c)) for c in ccs if len(c)==1]
    comps=[c for c in ccs if len(c)>1]
    stamps={}
    for comp in comps:
        cnt=Counter(di[p[0]][p[1]] for p in comp)
        mc=min(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
        tl=(min(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp))
        mcpos=next(p for p in comp if di[p[0]][p[1]]==mc)
        rel=[(p[0]-mcpos[0],p[1]-mcpos[1],di[p[0]][p[1]]) for p in comp]
        stamps[mc]=(rel,tl,mcpos)
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in di]
    for mc,(rel,tl,mcp) in stamps.items():
        for m in singles:
            if di[m[0]][m[1]]!=mc: continue
            # stamp placed so minority cell = marker => dr = m - mcp, dc = m - mcpos (offset relative to stamp bbox TL)
            sdr=m[0]-tl[0]; sdc=m[1]-tl[1]
            for dr,dc,v in rel:
                rr,cc_=sdr+dr,sdc+dc
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc_<W: out[rr][cc_]=v
    return out

            for a in(-1,0,1):

                    r=(q[0]+a,q[1]+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        out.append(cp)
    return out
def dihed_variants(cells):
    offs=[(p[0]-cells[0][0],p[1]-cells[0][1]) for p in cells]
    def norm(pts):
        rs=[r for r,c in pts];cs=[c for r,c in pts]
        o=(min(rs),min(cs))
        return [(r-o[0],c-o[1]) for r,c in pts]
    V={'id':norm(offs)}
    cur=offs
    V['rot90']=norm([(c,-r) for r,c in cur])
    cur=[(c,-r) for r,c in cur]
    V['rot180']=norm(cur)
    cur=[(c,-r) for r,c in cur]
    V['rot270']=norm(cur)
    V['h']=norm([(r,-c) for r,c in offs])

    V['th']=norm([(-c,r) for r,c in offs])
    V['tv']=norm([(c,-r) for r,c in offs])

from collections import Counter
def cc(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg}; out=[];used=set()
    for p in sorted(S):
        if p in used: continue
        st=[p];cp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q);cp.append(q)
            for a in(-1,0,1):
                for b in(-1,0,1):
                    r=(q[0]+a,q[1]+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        out.append(cp)
    return out
def f(di,variants=True):
    H=len(di); W=len(di[0])

        V={'id':norm([(dr,dc) for dr,dc,v in []])}

from collections import Counter
def cc(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg}; out=[];used=set()
    for p in sorted(S):
        if p in used: continue
        st=[p];cp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q);cp.append(q)
            for a in(-1,0,1):
                for b in(-1,0,1):
                    r=(q[0]+a,q[1]+b)
                    if r in S and r not in used: st.append(r)
        out.append(cp)
    return out
def norm(pts):
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
    o=(min(rs),min(cs))
    return [(r-o[0],c-o[1]) for r,c in pts]
def solve(di):
    H=len(di); W=len(di[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in di for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ccs=cc(di,bg)
    comps=[c for c in ccs if len(c)>1]
    singles=sorted(set(next(iter(c)) for c in ccs if len(c)==1))
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in di]
    for comp in comps:
        cnt=Counter(di[p[0]][p[1]] for p in comp)
        maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        anc=[p for p in comp if di[p[0]][p[1]]!=maj][0]
        offs=[(p[0]-anc[0],p[1]-anc[1],di[p[0]][p[1]]) for p in comp]
        def nrm(pts):
            rs=[r for r,c,v in pts]; cs=[c for r,c,v in pts]
            o=(min(rs),min(cs))
            return [(r-o[0],c-o[1],v) for r,c,v in pts]
        V=nrm(offs)
        mir=[(dc,-dr,v) for dr,dc,v in offs]
        M=nrm(mir)
        for mk in singles:
            if di[mk[0]][mk[1]]!=di[anc[0]][anc[1]]: continue
            for shp in (V,M):
                for dr,dc,v in shp:
                    rr,cc_=mk[0]+dr,mk[1]+dc
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc_<W and out[rr][cc_]==bg: out[rr][cc_]=v
    return out
